thread:
jeff: opened a docs PR to clarify Dedicated provisioning eviction + autoscale cooldown details: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1724
jeff: TL;DR: make eviction behavior explicit, show tiny terraform + python snippets for scale policy, and add a short migration note for old cooldown keys.
mina: quick ask: can we be explicit about what happens to in-flight requests when preemption_policy="notify-and-drain" vs "immediate"? customers keep asking.
harper: added a short paragraph: notify-and-drain lets in-flight requests finish (bounded by request timeout), immediate may abort strongly-consistent sessions.
mina: nice. can you also include a jq migration one-liner converting `scaleCooldownMs` (ms) -> `cooldown_seconds` (s)? infra folks like copy-paste.
jeff: adding examples now. terraform snippet:
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_scale_policy" "example" {
  tenant_id         = "tenant-201"
  min_gpus          = 1
  max_gpus          = 4
  cooldown_seconds  = 180
  preemption_policy = "notify-and-drain"
}
```
python snippet:
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
client.set_scale_policy(tenant_id="tenant-201", min_gpus=1, max_gpus=4, cooldown_seconds=180, preemption_policy="notify-and-drain")
```
migration jq one-liner:
```bash
jq '.cooldown_seconds = (.scaleCooldownMs / 1000 | floor) | del(.scaleCooldownMs)' policy.json > policy.migrated.json
```
ravi: small nit: add a sentence in the docs and changelog clarifying this is docs-only (no runtime behavior change). avoids support churn.
jeff: done, added changelog entry and assigned @mina for a quick review. merging after green.
docs-bot: doc build succeeded for branch docs/pr-1724 (links: 0 warn, lint: ok)
mina: LGTM, merging. cc: @support to watch for questions about preemption wording. :thumbsup:
notes: Short coordination thread for docs PR 1724: eviction clarity, tiny terraform+python SDK snippets, jq migration example, changelog note, and doc-bot confirmation. Messages are concise Slack-style with inline code blocks.
